meta.parties: Ratgama Pannasekera Nayaka Thero v. Caldera

rules.statement: A beneficiary has a right to the rents and profits of trust property, subject to the provisions of the instrument of trust, and can compel trustees to perform their duties or restrain them from committing breaches of trust.
rules.supporting_quote: "The beneficiary has, subject to the provisions of the instrument of trust, a right to the rents and profits of the trust property. The beneficiary has a right to compel a trustee to perform his duty and restrain him from committing any contemplated or probable breach of trust."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 57 of the Trusts Ordinance (Cap. 72) states :- "The beneficiary has, subject to the provisions of the instrument of trust, a right to the rents and profits of the trust property." Section 63 of the Trusts Ordinance states :- "The beneficiary has a right to compel a trustee to perform his duty and restrain him from committing any contemplated or probable breach of trust."
